name: learner_profile
description: Private learner goals, targets, schedule, and onboarding preferences for one Parle account

user_id.description: Buildy account id for the learner who owns this profile

goals.description: Selected stable goal ids: canada_immigration, canadian_citizenship, conversation, general_fluency, work, job_interview, school, or other

main_goal.description: The selected primary goal id; it determines the learner track

other_goal_text.description: Learner-written detail when the other goal is selected

track.description: Learning track determined by the main goal

target_per_skill.description: JSON object serialized as a string, keyed by L, R, W, and S; values are NCLC level strings, CEFR level strings, or null when no target is set

target_date.description: Requested target date in YYYY-MM-DD form; empty when no deadline is set

no_deadline.description: Whether the learner selected no deadline

test_booked.description: Whether an immigration-track TEF or TCF test has been booked

test_booked_date.description: Booked TEF or TCF date in YYYY-MM-DD form; empty when no test is booked or the track does not use this field

availability.description: JSON object serialized as a string, mapping selected lowercase weekday ids to minutes available per day

tutor_windows.description: Optional selected lesson windows such as weekday_morning or weekend_evening

tutor_budget_band.description: Optional hourly tutor budget; none means do not suggest paid lessons, unspecified means the learner did not choose a budget

self_assessed_level.description: Starting level mapped from the learner's self-assessment, not a placement score

time_zone.description: Learner's IANA time zone, detected from the browser and editable during onboarding
